title: Smoking, drinking and smoky clubs
summary: He talks about cigarettes and smoke in clubs like Bradley's.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: I miss 'em. I don't miss after the first drag. You know, the second one is "eh..." It's like drinking a beer. The first time you hold that glass up to your mouth, it goes
down, it's so cool and it tastes so good. But the next one is just nothin' but slop.
Yeah, with the cigarettes, it's lighting it and putting...
The cigarette, and lighting it... It's the motion. It's a habit.
I do it a lot when I write. When I write, I light it up and I put it in the ashtray, I go on the typewriter...

I used to do it when I'd play. I'd light a cigarette, I'd take a drag, put it in the ashtray and I'd play, then I'd turn around and it was out. So I didn't really smoke as much as people thought I did. I was inhaling smoke from the club. There's all kinds of cigarette smoke in the club.
Oh yeah. Especially some of them, like the Village Vanguard, when you look in the spotlight...

Oh...and Bradley's! Bradley's is terrible. There's only one way to work in a joint like that, and that's wear a (?) mask. I got one. And I don't give a damn whether they think I look funny or what they do. I'll wear it.
